normality_definition:
A small square glass bottle with a screw cap. The bottle carries exactly two labels.

LABELS:
- Top label (fruit icon label): attached to the center of the bottle body. Contains a clearly visible fruit icon/image positioned at the center of the label. This label is positioned in the upper portion of the bottle body.
- Bottom label: attached to the lower part of the bottle body, below the top label. Contains the text '100% Juice'. The top label is always higher on the bottle than the bottom label.

FILL LEVEL:
- The bottle is filled with juice to at least 90% of its capacity, but not 100%. A small but visible gap exists between the juice surface and the bottle cap/neck.
- The bottle is never empty or nearly empty.

JUICE-LABEL CONSISTENCY:
- The color and type of the juice inside the bottle matches the fruit depicted in the icon on the top label (e.g., orange juice with an orange icon, banana juice with a banana icon).

Note: Juice type and fruit icon vary across normal images — what matters is that they are consistent with each other.
